name: Tyrion Cuthbert: Beyond the Arcane
summary: Also known as Tyrion 2, the game is a direct sequel to Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane. The plot of Beyond the Arcane will be centered on a worldwide conspiracy that involved Tyrion’s late mother and the Theocracy of Lumina. With Frey Cuthbert at the center of this mystery, Tyrion will be embarking on a world-spanning investigation to uncover who his mother really was, why she fled to Wyverngarde, and why the powers that be seem to be so interested in his newly awakened abilities.
